candidates.statement: Checkout 502s (~2s) stem from order's calls to payment timing out: payment POST /v1/authorizations shows transport ReadTimeout (~2s) while inventory/redis reservations succeed in ms, so the failure is downstream payment latency, not inventory.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side server metrics/logs absent; payment latency inferred from client-side ReadTimeout spans only.

report.explanation: Traces show order->payment POST /v1/authorizations failing with transport ReadTimeout at ~2s, propagating 502 to /v1/orders and /v1/checkout, while inventory reservations and redis succeed quickly. Gateway logs confirm order client transport errors. Bounded candidate: downstream payment latency.
